tests.description: Native/real RTL CSR hardware integration with independent oracle and real owner peer

override: Rust hardware backend; explicit user real compile RED replaces generic JS skip. Cargo intentionally not run by worker.

oracle_probe.scope: Standalone vector/oracle coverage only, no product execution

coverage: All 16 WSTRB for RW/WO/W1C/external RW; zero-value write commits
RO reserved high inputs and dynamic snapshot; external RW reserved-bit masking separate test
Unknown/high/unaligned address and permission errors; no alias
W1C set priority and independent event during error/backpressure
Pre-edge combinational commits; reset cancellation; 31-cycle stalls
3 seeds native Interpreter/Compiled and actual Icarus leaf
Same-session leaf+counter peer+top; peer reject=candidate[31] && current[0]; write wins increment
limitations: Native/RTL not run until coordinator captures compile RED; no green product claim
First pre-reset frame not compared; comparisons start after first reset edge
Leaf error only SLVERR; system DECERR is later story
